|errata_history=This is the original printing (version 1 of 2) of the Virtual Modern card. It is not the current version; the current version is [[Something Special Planned For Them (V) (Errata)]] (PC-E1). The image is the Players Committee card image of this version ([[:File:V0-D-somethingspecialplannedforthem-2018-07-08.gif]]). Each version below is a published PC card image; dates are the upload dates in the PC's image repository (each image proves its text existed then; the errata may have been announced a few days later). Card images that changed in any visible way are separate versions (Bill, 12 Nov 2026).
